user_story: As a product owner I can compare without-ctx and adaptive ctx behavior on the same task.

user_story: As an operator I get a durable record of failures and bounded retries.

reviewer_verdict: Review blockers fixed in code; live recovery remains.

user_story: As a ctx user I receive useful context without paying for every available tool.

user_story: As a reviewer I get order-balanced results even when scenarios are filtered.

user_story: As a benchmark reviewer I can trust that a reviewer agent really completed its assigned review.
expected_behavior: Full treatment credits reviewer use only when an error-free selected spawn is followed by a completed non-empty wait and close for the same agent in that order.

repro: Feed observed_agent_review a completed event with a non-null error or reverse the valid spawn-wait-close events.

reviewer_verdict: Pass: independent recheck closed the P1 with valid error-stage mismatched-ID reverse-order and success probes.

user_story: As a ctx user I do not pay prompt or tool overhead for capabilities that were not selected.
expected_behavior: Baseline and ctx-light explicitly disable multi-agent and expose no ctx MCP configuration; only ctx-full enables both surfaces.
evidence: Command-construction regression checks disable/no-MCP for light and enable/MCP for full; focused gate passes.
repro: Build Codex commands for with_ctx false and true then inspect feature flags and MCP config arguments.
risk: Merely exposing unused agent or MCP schemas can inflate cached context and lets baseline behavior escape the intended policy.

reviewer_verdict: Pass: independent product-path probes confirmed recommendation does not auto-load entities and the old harness forced the expensive surfaces.

user_story: As a host integrator I receive a bounded adaptive activation proposal instead of an instruction to load every candidate.
expected_behavior: context_policy proposes at most one local directly usable skill for immediate load; active baseline external malformed and expensive candidates stay kept manual or deferred.

repro: Call ctx__recommend_bundle with active baseline external malformed skill agent and MCP rows then inspect keep load deferred and manual.
risk: A naive host can interpret the advisory load list literally and recreate the forced-full slowdown in production.
fix: Load one eligible skill; exclude kept context; defer agents MCPs and secondary skills; fail closed on external or malformed metadata.
reviewer_verdict: Approved after two review rounds and direct adversarial probes.

user_story: As a ctx run user I send only the ctx schemas configured for the current stage of work.

user_story: As a developer I receive a small ranked skill selection rather than a bulk context merge.

reviewer_verdict: Approved after reviewer reproduced and closed all four findings.

user_story: As a ctx run user I have selected skills, MCPs, and agents activated and unloaded as task evidence changes without exposing every capability up front.
expected_behavior: The host control plane recommends outside model turns; each provider turn receives bounded selected context; lifecycle distinguishes selection, delivery, adoption, use, and unload; final state is empty.
evidence: Commit 70dd4917 fixed delivery and terminal attestation. Commit d4786ccb added a pure default-deny deferred decision policy with strict public-evidence schemas, explicit safety flags, provenance, permissions, risk, and recursive oracle rejection; 116 benchmark tests and local-fast passed 10 lanes with 5737 tests passing.
repro: Run held-out private production pairs and require exact lifecycle ordering, cleanup, final empty state, and naturally policy-triggered MCP or reviewer execution in a separate conformance suite.

reviewer_verdict: Keep open: skill delivery, cleanup, and deferred decisions are fixed; deferred execution plus live conformance evidence remain required.

user_story: As a benchmark reviewer I can prove which provider, model, ctx runtime, source revision, catalog source, and treatment produced every scored result.

repro: Alter provider or runtime attestation, generated runtime file bytes, availability JSON, harness state, or arm treatment and validate the run.
risk: Unattested or falsely bound evidence can measure different code or context while appearing reproducible.
fix: Bind every declared runtime file to source bytes, version cache keys, require clean committed live runs, and exclude unverifiable trials.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: independent adversarial re-review accepted build and cache-hit provenance; efficiency collection remains separately open.

user_story: As a benchmark reviewer I can trust that the model cannot inspect evaluator controls, credentials, sibling prompts, or unrestricted network.

evidence: Both evaluator-isolation.json files in ctx-ab-20260727T221130Z-7af605ce report verified=true, network canary denied, git=0, project=0, and every sensitive read denied.
repro: Run one production pair and inspect per-arm evaluator-isolation.json plus a post-run sensitive filename scan.

fix: Use per-arm 0700 homes, 0600 transient auth, explicit deny paths, loopback canaries, project canaries, and finally cleanup.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: independent security and benchmark reviewers accepted the isolation evidence.

user_story: As a benchmark operator I cannot accidentally publish evidence from changing code.
expected_behavior: Live production execution starts only from a clean committed worktree and records immutable harness and scenario hashes.
evidence: Commit 25a3c082 rejected all five dirty paths before model execution; local-fast passed all 10 lanes with 9 workers in 41.194 seconds; clean canary ctx-ab-20260727T224009Z-61640368 records repository clean=true and an empty tracked diff hash.
repro: Modify one tracked file and run the private live command; it must exit before catalog/model work. Commit, rerun local-fast, and verify all lane return codes are zero before the canary.
risk: Dirty evidence cannot be reproduced or attributed to the merged implementation.
fix: Fail closed on dirty repository state and run all local gates from isolated committed-HEAD worktrees.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: reviewer accepted the gate and the first frozen clean canary exercised it successfully.

user_story: As a benchmark owner I can keep real evaluator tests and reference patches unavailable to agents and public source.
expected_behavior: Historical or held-out scenarios live only in an ignored 0700 directory with 0600 files; tracked scenario packs contain public synthetic examples only.

risk: Public hidden tests invalidate holdouts and readable local files leak evaluator answers.

reviewer_verdict: Pass: CTO review closed the tracked-oracle blocker.

user_story: As a product owner I can explain token overhead using measured prompt and tool behavior rather than guesses.
expected_behavior: Every live arm records prompt bytes, command count, failures, total and maximum tool output, oversized output count, repeated command count, messages, and exact terminal token fields.

repro: Inject repeated and greater-than-32KiB command outputs into JSONL, then inspect summary metrics and the real calibration trace.

fix: Persist bounded trace metrics and predeclare a 32KiB per-command ceiling for confirmatory trials.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: forensic reviewer accepted the measurements while correctly rejecting a single-run causal claim.

user_story: As a reviewer I can prove that the runtime guidance hashed in provenance is exactly what the shipped installer generated.
expected_behavior: Every file declared by runtime-availability.json must exist with identical bytes in the installed catalog on build and cache hit; provenance records path, SHA-256, and size.
evidence: Commit 25a3c082; version-2 dry run ctx-ab-20260727T223036Z-1d7e43ad bound seven files and cache-hit run ctx-ab-20260727T223114Z-0be5b69e revalidated them. Adversarial packaged-copy mismatch and tampering regressions pass.
repro: Make the benchmark hash one availability pack while the installer writes different skill bytes; catalog preparation must fail.
risk: A cache can claim a source hash it never consumed, invalidating recommendation provenance.
fix: Compare exact declared bytes to generated files before caching and on every cache read; version the cache schema.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: the same reviewer who found the mismatch re-ran the adversarial proof and returned APPROVE with no blockers.

user_story: As a developer I receive language-specific runtime guidance when my host supplies language as structured context rather than repeating it in prose.
expected_behavior: The normalized language field contributes a retrieval tag, preserves wrong-language filtering, and loads the best available language-specific skill without changing established rankings.
evidence: Commit 48709ca8; attrs dry run ctx-ab-20260727T224932Z-326986c4 reproduced the missing skill, and ctx-ab-20260727T225220Z-f54e573f selected skill:ctx-python-testing for both identical scenarios after the fix. Local-fast then passed all 10 lanes in 44.27 seconds with 5710 unit tests passing.
repro: Recommend for query 'fix and review frozen attrs field setter policy compatibility' with language=python, local_code_task=true, and no_api_keys=true; compare tags, results, and context_policy before and after the commit.

user_story: As a benchmark reviewer I can trust lifecycle order and know whether the committed harness and environment manifest still match at run completion.
expected_behavior: Delivery precedes unload and session_end; the digest covers terminal events; repository HEAD/diff and the pristine in-memory environment manifest are compared at completion; any mismatch invalidates every efficiency or product claim.
evidence: Commit 70dd4917; 94 benchmark tests and committed-head local-fast passed all 10 lanes in 47.822 seconds with 5715 unit tests passing. Corrected dry runs ctx-ab-20260727T232717Z-5c76ff5e, ctx-ab-20260727T232728Z-c94ea15c, and ctx-ab-20260727T232738Z-57479ff7 report both end attestations true and zero incidents.
repro: Change HEAD or tracked files during a run, tamper valid environment JSON, or alter a dry-run manifest; require a run-attestation incident, nonzero exit, ineligible rows, and product_claim_eligible=false.
risk: Startup-only cleanliness can mislabel evidence if another worker edits or commits during long trials; mutable manifests can preserve false provenance.
fix: Retain the startup manifest in process memory, compare exact serialized bytes at completion, use precise matches-at-end wording, and fail closed for live and dry-run evidence.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: independent adversarial reviewer reproduced five initial findings, verified all corrections, and returned APPROVE with no remaining findings.

user_story: As a host operator I can evaluate deferred MCP and agent candidates without exposing hidden evaluator data or automatically running an unsafe capability.
expected_behavior: The pure host policy validates complete public task, activation, run, and context evidence; requires explicit false external-service, API-key, and install flags; checks provenance, permissions, and risk; selects at most one phase-appropriate capability; and otherwise denies without changing the task prompt.
evidence: Commit d4786ccb; 116 benchmark tests passed, the adversarial reviewer returned APPROVE after closing boolean-spoofing, recursive-oracle, duplicate-ID, null-provenance, malformed-candidate, and external-install gaps, and committed-head local-fast passed all 10 lanes with 5737 tests passing in 49.163 seconds.
repro: Pass malformed or duplicate candidates, missing or non-boolean safety flags, oracle-like nested values, null provenance, undeclared permissions, wrong-phase entity types, and valid local MCP or reviewer evidence to decide_deferred_activation.
risk: A permissive policy could activate an external or poisoned capability, leak hidden evaluation data, or silently alter the treatment prompt.
fix: Use strict fail-closed schemas, recursive hidden-data rejection, positive local-status allowlists, bounded permissions and risk, and immutable prompt-hash evidence.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: default-deny decision semantics and adversarial boundary cases are verified; execution is tracked separately in BENCH-021.

user_story: As a ctx user I do not pay prompt and setup cost for guidance that only repeats the task language and adds no task-specific capability.
expected_behavior: When a selected skill matches only the normalized scenario language and no intent-specific tag, CTX records a verified policy abstention, selects nothing, leaves the treatment prompt unchanged, and remains eligible for honest no-op comparison.
evidence: Commit e8abed6f implements fail-closed language-only abstention, sealed final attestations, exact schedule enforcement, and trusted policy KPIs. Two independent reviewers approved after adversarial forged, tampered, malformed, wrong-language, constraint-only, and intent-specific cases; 135 benchmark tests passed. Dry run ctx-ab-20260728-abstention-kpi-wip confirms no selection, body fetch, prompt change, or loaded terminal state; a real current-head model turn is still required to verify the live abstention.
repro: From a clean current committed head, run six pairs for a frozen scenario that produces an exact language-only match; require policy_abstention_verified=true, unchanged prompt hashes, zero selected and loaded context, sealed final attestations, complete exact token evidence, and no unresolved incidents.
risk: An overbroad abstention rule could hide useful language expertise or overfit one observed benchmark; a dry run cannot prove the live model-turn evidence boundary.
fix: Gate only an exact non-empty language-only match, fetch no body, preserve candidate and lifecycle evidence, seal results after terminal attestation, and exclude forged or untrusted rows from claims and KPI numerators.
reviewer_verdict: Implementation approved with no findings; keep open only for a clean current-head live rerun and paired KPI result.

user_story: As a release reviewer I can bind every local-fast result to the exact committed head and execution window.
expected_behavior: The summary JSON records a schema version, UTC start and finish timestamps, exact HEAD SHA, resolved merge-base SHA, profile, committed-head semantics, dirty state at selection, exact changed paths, worker count, lane timings, and return codes; every lane runs the captured HEAD.
evidence: Commits 3f41e438 and a61237cd. Two independent reviewers approved after closing classification-before-SHA, mutable-base, ambiguous-dirty-state, and timestamp-typing findings. The rolling .gate/local-fast.json now binds clean head c62c81cbfcfd6a626ccbe0718f890837ee4dc5cd to base a38d9f771f1bfeb21e224801ee28d39616170c56, records 14 changed paths, 11 lanes, 9 workers, an ordered UTC window, returncode 0, and 46.587 seconds. Later runs intentionally replace this ignored local artifact.
repro: Run scripts/no_mistakes_run.sh fast --summary-json .gate/local-fast.json, compare head_sha to git rev-parse HEAD, verify base_sha is the merge base, require source_worktree_dirty_at_selection=false and every lane returncode=0.
risk: Without immutable selection and execution revisions, a copied green summary or concurrent commit can misattribute lane selection and results.
fix: Capture head and merge-base before classification, classify against those SHAs, recheck HEAD, pin every worktree to the captured revision, and serialize exact provenance.
reviewer_verdict: Pass: CTO and independent reviewer approved; the current exact committed-head integration artifact is green with no failed lanes.

user_story: As a product owner I receive uncertainty-aware CTX benefit evidence that does not treat repeated trials as independent repositories.
expected_behavior: Product-level verdicts collapse paired trials to scenario medians and scenarios to repository medians, require a frozen repository identity for every attempt, and use an exact repository-support test without inflating the independent sample count.
evidence: Commit c62c81cb; 138 focused benchmark tests passed. The rolling .gate/local-fast.json binds clean head c62c81cbfcfd6a626ccbe0718f890837ee4dc5cd to 11 green lanes, 9 workers, returncode 0, and 46.587 seconds; it does not retain pytest or coverage output.
repro: Construct three unanimous repositories, one dominant repository, missing or malformed mappings, retry-time relabeling, case-only aliases, five unanimous repositories, and a matrix with mostly verified abstentions plus one verified delivery; inspect repository_cluster_analysis, ctx_policy_outcomes, and product_benefit_verdict.
risk: Pseudoreplication, forged repository labels, or interpreting a policy-assignment effect as universal delivered-context causality could make evidence look stronger than it is.
fix: Require six scenarios, five canonical repositories, six trials, exact frozen URL identity on every attempt, at least one verified delivery overall, trusted delivery or verified abstention for every CTX assignment, all-repository quality and non-regression, and exact one-sided support p at most 0.05.
